Name: Agag, King of Amalek
Summary: Agag was king of the Amalekites when Saul defeated them. Saul spared him against God's command, and Samuel put him to death at Gilgal, declaring that as Agag's sword had bereaved mothers, so his mother would be childless.
KeyStory: Agag's spared life exposed Saul's disobedience, and Samuel finished the judgment Saul refused.
LifeLesson: Partial obedience is disobedience, and someone else often has to finish what we refuse.
